title: Income Rates on Reduced Withholding for Veterans Pension Recipients (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery)
content:
The annual countable income of a debtor with a running **Veterans Pension** award sets an income rate on the approved monthly reduced withholding on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

**Rule.** A debtor with a running Veterans Pension award whose annual countable income is no more than the low-income limit of 10000.00 USD takes the low-income rate of 92 percent. One whose countable income is above 10000.00 USD but no more than the mid-income limit of 20000.00 USD takes the mid-income rate of 96 percent. Any other debtor takes no income rate under this rule.

The annual countable income is the figure recorded on the debtor's Veterans Pension award. The income rate is a percentage by which the approved figure is multiplied before the withholding is rounded up to the cent.

| Countable income (running pension) | Income rate |
|---|---|
| Up to and including 10,000.00 USD | 92 percent |
| Above 10,000.00 USD, up to and including 20,000.00 USD | 96 percent |
| Above 20,000.00 USD | None |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** 10,000.00 USD: 92 percent. 10,000.01 USD: 96 percent. 20,000.00 USD: 96 percent. 20,000.01 USD: none.
